name: Failed-flush continuation short (15m short the new-low bleed)
rationale: MECHANISM (the anti-H1): not every OI drop is capitulation-complete. When OI falls YET price prints a FRESH low (range_position pinned at the bottom, no bounce), longs are being liquidated but the SELLING has not exhausted — more forced sellers remain below. The counterparty to our short is the next tranche of margin-called longs about to be liquidated at lower levels. This identifies cascades still mid-acceleration (Oct-2025 went 14.6x mid-event) rather than done. Edge persists because clustered liquidation ladders are mechanical — if price is still making lows on falling OI, the ladder below is not yet consumed. Run as a perp SHORT. Entry: open_interest cross_down (deleveraging underway) AND range_position below a very low floor (making new lows, NO bounce) AND rsi below an oversold floor (momentum still down) AND funding_rate below a small-negative ceiling (shorts not yet crowded, room to fall). DISCONFIRMER: this must be economically MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with H1 in time — if the same OI-flush bars profit both as a long (H1) and this continuation-short, the signal is coin-flip noise; the distinguisher is range_position (basing vs new-low), so removing range_position must collapse this spec. HIGHEST curve-fit risk — kill unless it holds a clean, low-overlap OOS window net of fees.
catalyst: OI cross_down while price makes a fresh low with no bounce — the ladder below is unconsumed
